zh: 金管局聯同港交所與杜拜金管局及納斯達克杜拜
四方聯合宣佈成立策略工作組
旨在加強兩地金融市場與監管機構之間聯繫
work.en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority, HKEX, Dubai Financial Services Authority, and Nasdaq Dubai have jointly announced the establishment of a Strategic Working Group. The initiative aims to strengthen cross-border financial and regulatory ties between Hong Kong and Dubai.

zh: 內地人工智能獨角獸月之暗面澄清市場傳聞
否認有意於上海及香港兩地進行雙重上市
相關傳聞為近日新股市場焦點之一
work.en: Chinese artificial intelligence startup Moonshot AI has officially denied rumors regarding plans for a dual listing in Shanghai and Hong Kong. The denial follows widespread market speculation concerning its upcoming IPO roadmap.

zh: 招商銀行原副行長施順華涉嫌違紀違法受查
施氏已於約三年半前正式退休
反映內地金融領域反腐力度持續深入推進
work.en: Shi Shunhua, former vice president of China Merchants Bank, is under investigation for suspected severe disciplinary violations, roughly three and a half years after his retirement. The probe underscores Beijing's ongoing anti-corruption campaign targeting the financial sector.

smalltalk_hk.headline: Haitian Flavouring Completes Full Acquisition of Amoy Food
smalltalk_hk.body: Mainland condiment giant Foshan Haitian Flavouring & Food has finalized the acquisition of a 100% stake in century-old Hong Kong brand Amoy Food from Trustar Capital. The deal value was not publicly disclosed as Haitian aims to accelerate its global expansion strategy.

smalltalk_hk.headline: China Approves Anta's €1.5 Billion Stake Acquisition in Puma
smalltalk_hk.body: China's State Administration for Market Regulation has cleared sportswear giant Anta to proceed with its €1.5 billion deal involving Puma.

smalltalk_hk.headline: JD.com's Ceconomy Remedy Proposals Face Competitor Pushback
smalltalk_hk.body: Remedies proposed by JD.com to address competition concerns regarding its planned acquisition of European electronics retailer Ceconomy have reportedly drawn criticism from industry rivals.

smalltalk_sg.headline: Syed Saddiq Invites Singapore Health Minister Ong Ye Kung to October Wedding
smalltalk_sg.body: Malaysian politician Syed Saddiq Abdul Rahman has invited Singapore's Health Minister Ong Ye Kung to attend his upcoming wedding this October. Saddiq quipped that the invitation upgraded bilateral relations to "wedding-invitation status."

smalltalk_sg.headline: Gemini Clinches Full Major Payment Institution License in Singapore
smalltalk_sg.body: Crypto platform Gemini has secured a full Major Payment Institution license from the Monetary Authority of Singapore. The approval allows the firm to offer cross-border money transfer and digital payment token services in the city-state.

smalltalk_sg.headline: Power Bank Fire at Little India MRT Handled by Staff
smalltalk_sg.body: A power bank caught fire at Little India MRT station and was quickly extinguished by station staff without further incident.

personal_hk.headline: 沙田圍呂明才小學39人疑食物中毒 下周一起取消現場午膳分份
personal_hk.body:
學校37名學童及2名職員進食滷水雞髀和長通粉後腹痛腹瀉，食安中心指示午膳供應商停業消毒。
校方宣佈下周一起暫停校內現場分份安排，全面改發獨立飯盒。

personal_hk.headline: 周一鳴：香港警察學院日後可頒授學士學位 預期今年底正式開始
personal_hk.body:
警察學院獲評審局批准可頒授安保及刑事調查榮譽學士學位，成為首個提供學位資歷的政府部門。
未有學士學位的員佐級警員預計今年底起，可透過約3至4年免費課程進修取得學位。

personal_hk.headline: 林文健：聲稱防癌疫苗事件已拘3人 與律政司商討後考慮提出檢控
personal_hk.body:
當局調查聲稱能防多種癌症的疫苗案，至今搜獲逾1400支未註冊針劑並拘捕3人。
衞生署指宣傳疑違不良醫藥廣告條例，若牽涉醫護人員會轉介醫委會跟進。

personal_sg.headline: Prime Minister Lawrence Wong: Higher salaries are not about me or the PAP government
personal_sg.body: Prime Minister Lawrence Wong thanked MPs for their debate and stressed that ministerial salary adjustments are focused on securing Singapore's future governance rather than serving himself or the ruling party.

personal_sg.headline: PM Lawrence Wong at the Singapore Kadayanallur Muslim League's 85th Anniversary Dinner
personal_sg.body: Prime Minister Lawrence Wong attended and addressed the 85th anniversary dinner of the Singapore Kadayanallur Muslim League.
